intent: A small danger-confirm dialog: a title, one message line, and a right-aligned Cancel + red Destructive confirm for irreversible actions.
guidance: Reach for it to confirm a destructive, irreversible action; the confirm button is red (Destructive) by default and the message is the whole body — spell out exactly what is lost in one plain sentence. Copy is fully prop-driven (title / message / confirmLabel / cancelLabel), so one dialog serves team, project, or any delete. The backdrop is on and both Escape and a backdrop click fire onClose, so treat dismissal as "cancel" and never lean on the dialog as the only guard. For a non-destructive confirm pass destructive={false} to swap the red confirm for a neutral Primary one.

anatomy.description: ModalHeader with the title (left) and the close X (right), on a bottom border. Title binds to the Radix DialogTitle.
Corner dismiss button (aria-label "Close"); calls onClose, same as Escape and a backdrop click.
A single body-medium paragraph holding the message — the dialog's entire content, not scrollable.
Right-aligned actions: Cancel (Ghost, onClose) then the confirm (Destructive by default / Primary when destructive={false}).

use_when: Confirming an irreversible, destructive action (delete team, project, layer).
A yes/no confirm where the affirmative choice should read as dangerous.
dont_use_when: A reversible action with undo — use a Notification toast with an Undo action.
Collecting input or several fields — use a full Modal/form.

tokens.note: This component's own JSX is fully token-bound (c-* / var(--composa-*)) with no hex. The only non-token value in the composition is the Modal backdrop, a hardcoded rgba(0,0,0,0.4) (special/modalbackdrop) owned by Modal, not this dialog.

a11y.role: dialog — Radix Dialog.Content supplies role=dialog + aria-modal, a focus trap, and Escape-to-close; the header title is bound to the Radix DialogTitle for the accessible name.
a11y.close: X is a real <button aria-label="Close">; a backdrop click and Escape also call onClose.
a11y.note: aria-describedby is intentionally undefined (from Modal); the message is not wired as the description.

code.example: <DeleteConfirmDialog open={open} onClose={close} onConfirm={remove} title="Delete team?" message="This permanently deletes the team and its projects. This can't be undone." confirmLabel="Delete team" />
